approach: Agents of a study job get a tree without the other systems' studies; Athena's own gate does not. Add `Snapshot::create_hiding(..., hidden: &[String])` in athena-git (existing `create` and public `materialize` keep their signatures and mean "full tree"). Hidden directories are dropped when the snapshot is materialized, so they are absent from both sides of the snapshot's diff; `change_list()` also drops stray paths under them and `hidden_writes()` reports those drops. `Athena::hidden_study_dirs(ctx)` in run/pin.rs reads the repository URL of the job's recorded pin and returns every `studies/<d>` at the base whose pin.json URL (normalised) differs or is unreadable; a change job has no pin and hides nothing. The producer snapshot and the verifier AGENT snapshot use it; checks, demonstration reverts and the baseline run on the unhidden tree. The reader cannot know the job type, so `read_for` hides when the request selects exactly one configured system, and (answer to finding 2) if the accepted reading is a capability that does not pin (a change job), that reading is discarded and the reader runs once more on the full tree. Last, add the hermes-agent table to athena.toml. Step 1 stops the producer if the base lacks the systems schema or a request-text selector (I grepped crates/athena-data/src/config.rs for `systems` and the whole copy for `capabilities.study.systems`: no match in the copy I read, so the base's selector form is unknown to me).

decisions.choice: Keep the gate on the full tree and hide only from the agents. Checks (run/mod.rs:1936-1937 via `verifier_snapshot`), demonstration reverts (run/checks.rs:663) and baseline checks (run/checks.rs:955) call the unhidden functions. `verification_stage` rebuilds the verifier snapshot with `verifier_snapshot_hiding` at the same `verify_dir` straight after destructuring `Checked` (verification.rs:40-50), before `candidate_view` (:58) and `inputs` (:64) are built, replacing `vsnap`, `prepared` and `tool_config_from_base`; the reruns at :313 and :341 use the hiding form too.
decisions.reason: The study check `cargo test --locked` (athena.toml:122-125) must see studies/firstmate-work-handling (athena-cli drain.rs:5017 `include_str!`, tests/drain.rs:6948, xtask site_page.rs:11, cap-study rules.rs:1435), so it runs on the full tree. The swap sits before :58 so the diff view and tool config come from the snapshot the verifier works in. Unchanged from the previous plan except where the findings below say.

rejected.why: Touches athena-cli tests, cap-study rules tests and the xtask site generator (site.rs:17); the site is out of scope.

rejected.option: Hide in the checks snapshot too
rejected.why: Every Hermes job would fail its own `cargo test` check on unchanged repository tests.

rejected.option: Swap just before the disk check (:157)
rejected.why: The brief's inputs would already carry the tool configuration and diff from the old snapshot.

decisions.choice: Leave `Snapshot::create` and public `materialize` as they are; add `create_hiding` and `materialize_hiding`. Only the reader, the producer snapshot and the verifier-agent snapshot call the hiding form.

So steward.rs and planning.rs stay in the deliverable list but are edited only if the compiler forces it (it does not for an unchanged `create`).

rejected.why: Forces edits in mod.rs, checks.rs, planning.rs and steward.rs, all passing an empty list.

decisions.choice: Choose the directories to hide by the URL of the job's recorded pin (`ctx.job.job.pin`): keep `studies/<d>` whose pin.json `repository_url` equals the pin's `url` after stripping a trailing `/` and `.git`; hide every other directory, including one whose pin.json is missing or not valid JSON. `study_pin`'s exact-match rule (pin.rs:99) stays.
decisions.reason: Directory name is not the system id (`firstmate-work-handling` vs `firstmate`), and the URL is the join key `study_pin` uses (pin.rs:99). Failing closed on an unreadable pin follows BRIEF S1. It does not depend on how the schema selects a system.

rejected.why: firstmate's own study would be hidden from its own job.

decisions.choice: Answers finding 2 (major). The reader hides other studies when the shared system selector (the one `pin_repo` uses; extracted as `study_system_url(config, request) -> Option<String>` in pin.rs only if it is private) returns exactly one URL, and the change-job reader is then corrected after the fact. `read_for` (reading.rs:472, signature unchanged; callers pin.rs:158, reading.rs:1058, :1263) computes `hidden = reader_hidden_dirs(jc, request)`. With an empty list it behaves exactly as today. With a non-empty list it runs the existing logic (refusal re-read included) with `read_once(..., &hidden)`. If the accepted reading names a capability whose `pins_repo()` is false (a change job; I looked the capability up in `self.capabilities` as pin_repo does at pin.rs:30), that reading is discarded and the reader runs once more with an empty list (seq = seq + invocations so far, spent = spent + their lowest cost, same pattern as reading.rs:496-514), and the second reading is the one returned; every invocation made is returned and recorded. If the full-tree run returns a pinning capability (study) the contradiction is returned as a read failure (`None`, invocations, `Some("the reader chose a study when it saw only its system's study and a change when it saw all studies; ask again naming the system")`), never as a reading, so no study reading is ever accepted from a full-tree reader. A reading that declines (capability None), a reader failure, and a study reading made in the hidden view are returned as they are.
decisions.reason: The request and criterion 2 say a change job's snapshots hold every study. The reader chooses the capability (reading.rs:719-730, set at :817), so `read_once` (:551) cannot know it; correcting after the choice is the only way that does not depend on the unseen schema's selector shape. Cost: one extra reader run, only for a request that selects one system and is read as a change. Only the contradictory case is new as a stop, and it is a read failure, not a refusal (ReadError::Failed path, reading.rs:489 and :648), so no reading is newly refused.

rejected.option: Hide in the reader only when the request uses an explicit selector form of the schema (finding's option b)
rejected.why: I could not read the schema's selector in this copy, so I cannot say a dedicated form exists; (a) works for any form.

rejected.option: Hide all studies from every reader
rejected.why: A change request about studies/firstmate-work-handling needs them.

rejected.option: Hide nothing from the reader

rejected.option: Accept the previous plan's trade-off (change-job reader loses the studies when a system id is named)

decisions.choice: `change_list()` drops entries at or under a hidden directory; `Snapshot::hidden_writes()` returns them; the producer loop (producer.rs after :413) prints one `hidden` line naming them. Nothing new goes in the job record.
decisions.reason: Hidden directories are absent from both the snapshot's base and work tree, so the diff never shows them as 'D'. `build_candidate` (run/candidate.rs:34) applies only the change entries to the full base tree, so hidden directories keep their base blobs and land byte-identical, including any later intervention commit on them. A stray write is not landed and the owner sees the attempt.

rejected.option: Refuse a job that writes under a hidden directory

decisions.choice: Tell the verifier, in code, what it cannot run. When the hidden list is non-empty, `verification_stage` pushes one entry onto `inputs.checks`: name `hidden-study-directories`, command `not a check`, passed true, detail naming each hidden directory and saying that tests which read them (athena-cli drain tests, xtask site_page, `cargo test -p athena-cap-study` rules tests) fail or do not compile in the verifier's own view, that the recorded checks ran on the full tree and decide, and that such failures are not evidence against the candidate.

rejected.why: Criterion 2 and BRIEF S1 require the verifier snapshot to lack the other studies.

rejected.option: Only document the limit for the producer
rejected.why: The verifier judges, so the risk is larger there.

decisions.choice: Answers finding 1 (minor): scope_guard.rs is touched only if forced. Its test helper `rig_with_space` (scope_guard.rs:1049-1060) strips every line starting `repo_url`/`repo_ref` from the repository's own athena.toml, as do the two listed helpers (run_pin_tests.rs:80-107, run/tests.rs:295-310). The new `[capabilities.study.systems.hermes-agent]` table is then left without its keys. Step 1 checks, by reading the base's config types, whether an empty systems table parses. If it parses, scope_guard.rs is not edited. If it does not, the producer makes the same three-line filter change there (drop `[capabilities.study.systems.*]` tables) and the final report names the file as outside the reading's list.
decisions.reason: A deliverable the reading lists (athena.toml) is what breaks the helper; without the edit every scope_guard test that parses athena.toml fails and `cargo test --locked` cannot pass. I cannot avoid it by changing the listed files, because the helper's source is the file itself.

rejected.why: Criterion 4 names the `[capabilities.study.systems.hermes-agent]` table header.

rejected.option: Always edit scope_guard.rs
rejected.why: Widens scope when the base schema may accept an empty table.

decisions.choice: Keep the agent-side cargo limitation, stated for the producer, the verifier and the cap-study rules tests: tests that read studies/firstmate-work-handling fail in a study agent's hidden snapshot; Athena's gate and CI on the full tree decide.
decisions.reason: Moving fixtures is out of scope (site, firstmate study); `include_str!` cannot be skipped. The producer's fmt and `cargo build` still work; the verifier is warned by the entry in decision 6.

rejected.option: Skip those tests when the directory is missing
rejected.why: A silent skip would hide real breakage; `include_str!` cannot be skipped.

decisions.choice: The separation covers `studies/<id>/` in agent snapshots only. The evidence snapshot (crates/athena-core/src/snapshot.rs:1-7, pointed at by verification.rs:179-212) still holds every file under records/, including other study jobs' records; this is recorded in docs/design/study-capability-m1.md and in the CHANGELOG entry as a known remaining channel for a follow-up job.

decisions.choice: Answers finding 3 (minor): criterion 1's firstmate half uses the real file. The test reads `studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json` at run time (`std::fs::read` of `concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../../studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json")`, not `include_str!`), commits those bytes into its fixture repository, asserts its `repository_url` equals firstmate's configured `repo_url` as parsed from the real athena.toml, and asserts the pinner request carries that file's `sha`.
decisions.reason: A literal SHA would let the real pin.json and athena.toml drift apart unnoticed. A run-time read, not `include_str!`, makes this one test fail by panic and not break compilation of the whole athena-core test binary in a Hermes agent's hidden view; it is the same limitation class as decision 8 and is named there.

rejected.option: `include_str!` of the real pin.json
rejected.why: In a Hermes job's hidden snapshot it would stop `cargo test -p athena-core` from compiling at all, not just one test.

rejected.option: A made-up SHA literal
rejected.why: Does not check the real configuration (finding 3).

decisions.choice: Answers finding 4 (minor): the criterion-3 fixture holds every commit shape the real branch has. Commit-shape table (rule outcome): (1) job commit on visible paths: lands as before; (2) job commit that also writes a hidden path: that entry dropped, rest lands, UI `hidden` line; (3) records-only commit (Athena's own `ask`/dispatch commits under records/, present on main in these tests because cutover_job is removed from the fixture config): records/ already absent from snapshots, unchanged; (4) owner-path (athena-exclude) commit: `classify` still hides it, unchanged and not exercised here (existing snapshot.rs tests); (5) intervention commit (a plain commit without an Athena trailer) editing studies/a after it was created: in the base tree, hidden from the study job's reader, producer and verifier-agent snapshots, visible to the gate; lands unchanged with the intervention's bytes; (6) retry-after-block landing (`BaseThenTree`) and kept-dir resume (`BaseThenDir`): seed tree materialized with the same list, so the change list is against the hidden base; covered by the snapshot.rs unit test with BaseThenTree. No landing, history-check or attribution classification function changes. The criterion-3 test adds the intervention commit between `add_studies` and `ask`, and asserts the landed `studies/a` bytes equal the intervention's bytes and the landed diff outside records/ names only README.md. It differs from the real repository in that records live on main in the fixture and not on athena/records.
decisions.reason: Hidden paths never enter the snapshot repository, so classification code never sees them. Callers of `change_list`: candidate.rs:34, run/mod.rs:948 and :2254, producer.rs:205, :217, :413 get the same result for an empty list.

rejected.option: Teach landing or the history check about hidden paths
rejected.why: Hidden paths never enter the snapshot repository.

demonstrations.method: Test `hermes_agent_pins_its_tag_and_firstmate_keeps_its_pin_json_sha` in run_pin_tests.rs. It parses `include_str!("../../../athena.toml")` with `athena_data::Config::parse` and asserts the hermes-agent system holds repo_url https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git and repo_ref v2026.9.24. It builds a repository from that text unstripped (only `[job_plan]` and `cutover_job` removed, as `config()` does at :84-97) and commits the real `studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json` bytes read at run time, then runs two study jobs through `Athena::ask` and `Athena::go`: one request selects hermes-agent, one firstmate. `Athena::go` calls `pin_repo` (pin.rs:22) before dispatch.
demonstrations.observes: The parse succeeds. For the hermes job `pinner.requests()` is exactly [("https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git", "v2026.9.24")]. For firstmate the real pin.json's `repository_url` equals firstmate's configured repo_url, `pinner.requests()` is [(that url, the real pin.json sha)], and the job record's `pin.sha` equals that sha.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the athena.toml entry the parse assertion finds no hermes-agent system. If hermes were pinned at `main`, `requests()` differs. If firstmate's `study_pin` override were lost, its request would carry the config ref, not the pin.json sha. If the real pin.json's URL and firstmate's repo_url drifted apart, the URL-equality assertion fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry `Athena::go` -> `pin_repo` (run/pin.rs:22). Fake: `CountingPinner::new(FAKE_SHA).echoing_full_shas()` (fake.rs:23-44), injected as the `pinner` field in `athena_with` (run_pin_tests.rs:257); `add_studies` exists (:615). The unstripped-config helper and the run-time read are added in step 8.

(b) run_pin_tests.rs `hidden_studies_study_job_agents_lack_other_studies`: studies a and b committed via `add_studies` with a pin.json URL each, two configured study systems, request selecting b, run through `Athena::ask` (`read_for`/`read_once`, reading.rs:472/:551) and `Athena::go` (producer_snapshot producer.rs:125; verifier agent snapshot via the swap in verification_stage). A `Tweak` on `FakeAgentDriver` records, per invocation, role and whether `spec.workdir.join("studies/a")` and `studies/b` exist. Asserts one Reader invocation. (c) `hidden_studies_plain_change_job_sees_all`: a change job through `Athena::ask`/`Athena::go` using the fake capability `PlainChange` (id "change", `pins_repo` false, check `true`) via the new `capability` parameter of `athena_with`, request naming no system; records the same three roles; one Reader invocation. (b) run_pin_tests.rs `hidden_directory_lands_unchanged_and_the_gate_still_sees_it`: fixture commits in order: initial, `add_studies` (a and b), an intervention commit (plain commit, no Athena trailer) editing studies/a/notes.md, then `ask` (its records commits under records/ are on main). A fake-driver study job selecting b runs through `Athena::go` to landing. The study fake capability gains a `check` field set to ["sh","-c","test -f studies/a/pin.json"], which runs for real in the gate's snapshot. The producer `Tweak` edits README.md and also writes studies/a/x.json. A recording UI keeps the lines. The test compares `git.show_file("HEAD", ...)` for every studies/a file with the bytes at the intervention commit, reads `git diff --name-status <base> HEAD` and removes paths under records/, and reads the stored `brief-verifier.md` (written at verification.rs:183) asserting it holds the `hidden-study-directories` entry naming studies/a, marked `not a check`, passed.
demonstrations.observes: The change list holds the README.md edit and no entry under studies/a: no 'D', no 'A'. The job lands. Every studies/a file in HEAD equals the intervention's bytes (so also byte-identical to the pre-run state), and the landed diff outside records/ holds only README.md. The UI shows the `hidden` line naming studies/a/x.json. The check passes (gate on the full tree) while the verifier agent's workdir lacks studies/a. Without the verifier entry, the brief assertion fails. If the hiding used the first commit's studies/a instead of the base tree, the intervention's bytes would not match.
